items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: Yeah, Eddie run the band. And Eddie left. And then next year, then I left.

ctx.x: Yeah, Eddie run the band. And Eddie left. And then next year, then I left. That was it. So that really, I really enjoy that band, Papa Celeste and Sam Morgan band. I really, that's two bands I really enjoy because I stayed with Sam a long time and I stayed with Papa. Yeah. Good while. Yeah, Papa had pretty good bands. He always had good musicians.

Oh, to go back to the Sam Morgan band, and you tell us when you made those records, was that in Chicago or where did you make those records, for Columbia? Yeah, we made those records out on Canal Street.
